paragraphs: QQQ is +1.99% versus the prior close. The Nasdaq Score is +17/100 (Cautiously Positive). Score path: pre-market -38 → now +17.

The main live drivers are Semiconductors are supportive: Live · SOX +3.57% | Nasdaq +1.74% | SOX vs Nasdaq +1.83 pp | SOXX vs Nasdaq +2.10 pp | SMH vs Nasdaq +1.59 pp. It changed from negative to positive after the baseline snapshot. Breadth are mixed: Live · Nasdaq-100 breadth: 62/101 advancing (61%) · 39 declining · 0 flat. It changed from negative to mixed after the baseline snapshot. Rates are a headwind: the 10Y is 5.131%, +4.1 bp since pre-market.
QQQ and its internal leadership are diverging, so the index move has weaker confirmation (semiconductors positive, mega-caps mixed, breadth mixed).

What would change the view: improvement would require a sustained 10Y move back below roughly 5.05%, broader participation. Deterioration would be reinforced by the 10Y remaining above 5.05% or extending higher, semiconductor leadership rolling over, a material volatility expansion.
